notes: Desktop/ceiling/pole-mount PTZ camera, not rack-mountable (omit rackUnits in catalog). Primary source: Sony's own spec-sheet PDF (avc-group.com-hosted, but content/format is Sony's official pro.sony data sheet, copyright Sony Corporation) plus cross-checked against Sony's official online Help Guide specifications page (helpguide.sony.net/rc/brc-am7) which matches exactly. Direct fetch of pro.sony/ue_US/products/ptz-network-cameras/brc-am7 returned HTTP 403 so the PDF data sheet and Help Guide were used instead. HDMI version (2.0) is inferred, not explicitly stated by Sony -- spec only lists max resolution/frame rate (3840x2160p59.94), which requires HDMI 2.0 bandwidth; marked medium-confidence in that one field even though overall confidence is high. The two RJ-45 VISCA remote-control ports are physically RJ-45 jacks carrying RS-422 serial protocol (not Ethernet data), so no eth-* grade was applied; connector kept as rj45 per the physical jack rather than rs422. The RJ-45 OPTION tally port is GPIO tally I/O, not IP networking, so it is marked bidirectional with no Ethernet grade. Audio has 2x XLR3 (line/mic/mic+48V) plus a 3.5mm stereo mini-jack mic input. Power: XLR4-DC (11-17V) or PoE++ (IEEE802.3bt Type 4 Class 8, 41.1-57.0V) -- only the physical DC connector is listed as a port per instructions (PoE is delivered via the LAN RJ-45, already listed).

ports.name: HDMI
ports.note: Type-A connector; outputs up to 3840x2160p59.94. Sony spec sheet does not state HDMI version explicitly; inferred from 4K60 output capability

ports.name: Optical Output (SFP+)
ports.note: SFP+ compliant optical output carrying the same signal as the 12G-SDI output; output only

ports.name: Audio In (Mic)
ports.note: 3.5mm stereo mini jack, plug-in power compatible

ports.name: Genlock In
ports.note: 1.0 Vp-p, 75 ohm reference sync input; not a data-graded connection

ports.name: TC In
ports.note: Timecode input only (labeled TC Input/TC Output but input-only per spec)

ports.name: Network (LAN)
ports.note: 1000BASE-T; also accepts PoE++ (IEEE802.3bt Type 4 Class 8) for power

ports.name: Network (OPTION)
ports.note: Red Tally I/O over RJ-45; GPIO tally signaling, not an IP data port

ports.name: Remote Control IO / Green Tally IO (VISCA IN)
ports.note: RS-422 VISCA control input over RJ-45

ports.name: Remote Control IO / Green Tally IO (VISCA OUT)
ports.note: RS-422 VISCA control output over RJ-45
